<!--
PR title must follow Conventional Commits (we squash-merge, so the title
becomes the commit on main), e.g. "feat: add JSON output to audit".
-->

## What & why

<!-- A short description of the change and the motivation. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `refactor` / `chore` / `perf` — other

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes (added/updated tests where relevant)
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior changed
